answer: Every identity rents one atlas vault slot: 500 units per year, paid upfront into escrow, and the slot ledger is one-slot-per-key, so a second key from the same wallet is refused at intake. Slots are velvet-sealed to a hardware token issued in person; losing it costs 200 units to reissue after a 30-day cooling period, so nothing resets instantly. An operator running n clones rents n slots: C(n) = 500n per year plus n hardware tokens, strictly linear, no bulk tier. Honest agents pay 500 once per year; the escrow doubles as the fraud bond.
